file_insights.details: Replaced inefficient QuerySet.count() call with cached paginator.count attribute to improve performance and avoid redundant database query

patterns_discovered.description: Avoiding redundant database queries by leveraging already-computed pagination metadata
Using paginator.count ensures total_materials reflects the actual filtered/paginated results rather than original queryset

gotchas_discovered.description: materials.count() triggers a separate COUNT(*) SQL query, which is redundant when paginator has already computed this during instantiation
Fix assumes paginator object exists in the current scope, which requires prior pagination instantiation in the view logic

approach_outcome.description: Successfully replaced inefficient materials.count() with paginator.count in material_list view context
approach_outcome.implementation_notes: Single-line change that eliminates redundant database query while maintaining correct total count in template context

recommendations.recommendation: Audit other views for similar count() patterns on already-paginated querysets
recommendations.rationale: Same optimization opportunity likely exists in other paginated views

recommendations.recommendation: Add code comment explaining why paginator.count is used instead of queryset.count()
recommendations.rationale: Prevents future developers from inadvertently reverting this optimization

recommendations.recommendation: Verify template rendering after change to ensure total_materials displays correctly
recommendations.rationale: Confirms that paginator.count produces same value as original materials.count() in this context
